scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs && node scripts/check-extension-build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:production: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:stable: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.stable.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:extension: npm run check && npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.extension.config.ts
